name: video-virale
description: Vidéo virale IA : lance l'infra (Docker), l'API, le worker, l'admin et ComfyUI depuis la racine.

scripts.dev: npm run infra && npm run migrate && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n api,worker,admin,comfy -c blue,magenta,green,yellow "npm:api" "npm:worker" "npm:admin" "npm:comfy"
scripts.comfy: curl -sf http://127.0.0.1:8188/system_stats >/dev/null && echo "ComfyUI déjà lancé sur :8188" || (cd ${COMFYUI_DIR:-../stabledifusion/ComfyUI} && venv/bin/python main.py --listen 127.0.0.1 --port 8188)
scripts.setup: test -f backend/.env || cp .env.example backend/.env; cd backend && python3.12 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -e '.[dev]' && cd ../admin && npm install
scripts.test: cd backend && .venv/bin/pytest && cd ../admin && npx vitest run
scripts.lint: cd backend && uvx ruff check app tests && uv run mypy app && cd ../admin && npx tsc -b && npm run lint
